completeness.why: The new getRangedScheduleAmount covers only the range arithmetic; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the preview each keep their own null/number/range ternary, although the existing getScheduledAmount decides all three cases, so they are partial. schedule-template.ts is untouched and keeps its halve-the-rounded-sum copy (which preserves its different rounding but could have been an explicit rounding argument), so it is none.

interface.why: getRangedScheduleAmount(range) is narrower than the decision (no missing/number cases) and has no argument for the template's different rounding, which is the one real variation; it also sits beside getScheduledAmount, which already covers the full decision.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff adds no new copy: getScheduledAmount delegates to the new helper. The per-site null/number dispatch copies are left in place unchanged rather than reshaped.
